readme: The twenty registry items for the face taste session, ready; appended to records/target/BOHEMIA_VOTE_REGISTRY.json by --register the round the moodboard lands, never before (rule 82/87).

items.title: 1 OF 20: A LINE ROUND THE HEAD?
items.why: The same face twice with one thing changed. UP picks the left picture, DOWN the right, and your taps become the rule for every face. You see it in the VOTE tab at 1:1 and zoomed.

diffs: THE ONE CHANGE: UP = no line, the face as it ships; DOWN = a 1-pixel dark line round the head; nothing else differs between the two sides.
THE CONTROL: the unchanged side is the face as it ships today (the twin), byte-identical to it at 1:1; no pack holds a character face to stand beside it (16c80eb7, f3090598).
THE HEAD IS A PLACEHOLDER under rule 108 ROUND THIRTEEN; the knob (line, colours, light, grime, strength, darkness, warmth, room, size) outlives the renderer.

items.parked: until the moodboard lands (rule 82/87); registered by tools/bohemia_portrait_taste_session.py --register
